description: Duty paid on imports as a share of their value, month by month, for one HS or national code (and optionally one partner country; default the world). Returns the calculated duty, the dutiable value, the consumption value and two effective rates: duty / consumption value (counted only where a duty is reported) and duty / dutiable value, plus the change of the first rate against the same month a year earlier in percentage points. It is a calculated duty as published by the source agency (not duty collected, and not the statutory tariff rate), on the imports-for-consumption basis. Only reporters that publish duty figures have it (see get_catalog, "measures"); other reporters get the error measure_unavailable. A month the source reports no duty for is null with a reason (source_null, incomplete when some items below report none), never 0. Imports only. Use it for the effective duty rate of an import item and how it moved.

code.description: Required. HS or national code (2, 4, 6 or the national digits); dots are ignored.

country.description: Optional partner country (ISO alpha-2 code or name); omit for the world total.

from.description: Optional first month, YYYY-MM (or YYYY). Default: 24 months before the last.

reporter.description: Required. The reporting country whose customs statistics are read: "JP" (Japan), "US" (United States), "GB" (United Kingdom) or "EU" (European Union (27 member states)). Partners are the other countries.

to.description: Optional last month, YYYY-MM (or YYYY). Default: the latest published month.

name: get_tariff_burden
